title: cicuta trachypleura
intro: Cicuta trachypleura, commonly known as Water Hemlock or Cowbane, is a highly toxic plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). Despite its toxicity, it has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cicuta trachypleura include pain relief, reduction of fever, and treatment of gastrointestinal issues. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
